info.name: AI Receptionist
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the AI Receptionist NestJS API.

Global prefix: /api
Versioning: URI (v1)
Authentication: Bearer JWT

After calling Login, the access_token is automatically saved to the {{accessToken}} collection variable.

request.description: GET /api — Returns a hello string. No authentication required.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Authentication endpoints: signup, login, token refresh, and profile.

The Login request includes a test script that automatically stores the JWT as {{accessToken}} and the refresh token as {{refreshToken}}.

body.raw:
{
	"email": "clinic@example.com",
	"password": "SecurePass123",
	"name": "Dr. Ahmed",
	"business_name": "Ahmed Dental Clinic",
	"business_phone": "+213555000001",
	"personal_phone": "+213555000002",
	"address": "123 Main Street, Algiers"
}

request.description:
POST /api/v1/auth/signup

Registers a new tenant.

Body (SignupDto):
- email (string, required) — valid email
- password (string, required) — 8-20 characters
- name (string, required)
- business_name (string, required)
- business_phone (string, required) — valid phone number
- personal_phone (string, required) — valid phone number
- address (string, optional)

POST /api/v1/auth/login

Authenticates a tenant and returns JWT tokens.
The test script automatically saves access_token → {{accessToken}} and refresh_token → {{refreshToken}}.

Body (LoginDto):
- email (string, required) — valid email
- password (string, required) — 8-20 characters

POST /api/v1/auth/refresh

Exchanges a refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair.
The test script automatically updates {{accessToken}} and {{refreshToken}}.

Body (RefreshTokenDto):
- refresh_token (string, required)

GET /api/v1/auth/me

Returns the authenticated tenant's profile including tenant_id.

Requires: Bearer {{accessToken}} (inherited from collection).
Guard: JwtAuthGuard

item.name: Services
item.description:
Service management endpoints.

All endpoints require Bearer authentication and the TenantContext interceptor (tenant_id is extracted from the JWT).

request.description:
POST /api/v1/services

Creates a new service for the authenticated tenant.

Requires: Bearer {{accessToken}}
Guards: JwtAuthGuard
Interceptors: TenantContextInterceptor

Body (CreateServiceDto):
- name (string, required)
- price (number, required) — max 2 decimal places, min 0
- duration_minutes (integer, required) — min 1

item.name: Doctors
item.description:
Doctor management endpoints.

All endpoints require Bearer authentication and the TenantContext interceptor.

request.description:
POST /api/v1/doctors

Creates a new doctor for the authenticated tenant.
The test script automatically saves the returned id → {{doctorId}}.

Requires: Bearer {{accessToken}}
Guards: JwtAuthGuard
Interceptors: TenantContextInterceptor

Body (CreateDoctorDto):
- name (string, required)
- service_ids (string[] of UUIDs, optional) — links the doctor to existing services

item.name: Doctor Hours
item.description:
Doctor availability / working hours endpoints.

All endpoints require Bearer authentication and the TenantContext interceptor.
All routes are nested under /api/v1/doctors/:doctorId/hours.

request.description:
POST /api/v1/doctors/:doctorId/hours

Creates working hours for a specific doctor.
The test script automatically saves the returned id → {{doctorHourId}}.

Requires: Bearer {{accessToken}}
Guards: JwtAuthGuard
Interceptors: TenantContextInterceptor

Path params:
- doctorId (UUID, required)

Body (CreateDoctorHoursDto):
- day (enum, required) — one of: MONDAY, TUESDAY, WEDNESDAY, THURSDAY, FRIDAY, SATURDAY, SUNDAY
- start_time (string, required) — e.g. "08:00"
- end_time (string, required) — e.g. "17:00"

Note: A doctor can only have one entry per day (unique constraint on [doctor_id, day]).

GET /api/v1/doctors/:doctorId/hours

Returns all working-hours entries for a specific doctor.

Requires: Bearer {{accessToken}}
Guards: JwtAuthGuard
Interceptors: TenantContextInterceptor

Path params:
- doctorId (UUID, required)

GET /api/v1/doctors/:doctorId/hours/:id

Returns a single doctor-hours entry by its ID.

Requires: Bearer {{accessToken}}
Guards: JwtAuthGuard
Interceptors: TenantContextInterceptor

Path params:
- doctorId (UUID, required)
- id (UUID, required) — the doctor_hours record ID

PATCH /api/v1/doctors/:doctorId/hours/:id

Partially updates a doctor-hours entry.

Requires: Bearer {{accessToken}}
Guards: JwtAuthGuard
Interceptors: TenantContextInterceptor

Path params:
- doctorId (UUID, required)
- id (UUID, required)

Body (UpdateDoctorHoursDto) — all fields optional:
- day (enum, optional) — MONDAY | TUESDAY | WEDNESDAY | THURSDAY | FRIDAY | SATURDAY | SUNDAY
- start_time (string, optional)
- end_time (string, optional)

DELETE /api/v1/doctors/:doctorId/hours/:id

Deletes a doctor-hours entry.

Requires: Bearer {{accessToken}}
Guards: JwtAuthGuard
Interceptors: TenantContextInterceptor

Path params:
- doctorId (UUID, required)
- id (UUID, required)
